caption: The drawing depicts a single female figure standing against a plain, off-white background. The figure has light skin, black hair styled close to the head, and pink cheeks. She is wearing a long, full dress that reaches her ankles, colored primarily light brown with a herringbone or woven pattern and scattered with small red decorative motifs. The dress is adorned with blue trim along the wide collar, sleeve cuffs, waistband, two tiers of ruffles, and the hem of the skirt. There is an additional decorative blue element, possibly a ribbon, around her neck. Her right arm is raised and bent at the elbow with the hand pointed outward, while her left arm hangs down by her side. She wears black shoes with short heels and white stockings. The paper has faint border marks, and the words "Leith-Varvier" are written in small print near the lower right corner. No other objects or elements are present in the composition.
title: Doll - "Abbie"
